_comment: Colorado House delegation by Congress. Shared by vote_scraper.py and index.html. 'csvName' + ' (' + id + ')' is the CSV column header, so never change csvName for a Congress that already has data. 'displayName' is the short name for table headers; 'fullName' is shown on summary cards. Optional 'note' is shown on the member's summary card (context for readers, e.g. an extended absence); optional 'noteUrl' (https only) adds a 'Read more' link after it. 'current' is the Congress the page shows by default. IDs are Bioguide IDs (bioguide.congress.gov), which match the name-id attributes in the Clerk's roll-call XML.

members.note: Missed 41 straight votes, Jan. 13 to Feb. 25, 2025, after giving birth; House rules didn't allow proxy voting at the time.
